checks.question: Is the physical base unregistered, malformed, or more than one token?
Does any segment use a token not registered in that closed segment?
Is a token that belongs to another segment absorbed into physical_base?
For an evaluated field at a position/region locus, is the join _of_ rather than the required _at_?
Does the name encode a sample or endpoint position that indexes a point rather than naming a quantity?
Does the name use an operator spelling the installed grammar has retired?
Does the name drop a distinguishing axis the source states for the observable?
Is the quantity ambiguous to a reader who sees only the name?
Does the name describe the measuring instrument's own state rather than the physical observable?
Does the name add a modifier the source does not state, on a form that makes it a claim?
Does the name assert a direction, mechanism, weighting or locus the authoritative DD doc does not support?
Which object does the name denote, read against its bound source path?
Do all bound source paths denote the same quantity?
Is a derived family parent judged as an over-specialised standalone name rather than the abstraction of its children?
Does a bare outline form erase an owner the source identifies?
Does the name conflate a coupled quantity with a launched/incident quantity?
Does the name encode value provenance (measured/reconstructed/reference) as a segment?
Does any operator use a non-canonical join form the installed grammar does not carry?
Are the name's segments out of the grammar's canonical order?
Is the spelling a non-canonical render of its parsed intermediate representation?
Does the name use a generic or collapsed locus/position token instead of the registered token for its source object?
Does the name collapse one registered advisory alias into another?
Does a plasma-shape parameter omit the surface locus that makes it meaningful?
Does the name carry a model author surname or model-specific identifier?
Does the name adopt a minority spelling against the catalog's established base?
Is a physically required segment (subject, component) missing?
Is the physical base inconsistent with the quantity's authoritative unit and kind?
Has the anchored source path changed so the name/documentation no longer matches it?

disagreements.name: volume_integrated_runaway_electron_density
disagreements.description: Total number of runaway electrons in the confined plasma, obtained by integrating the local density of the accelerating suprathermal tail.

disagreements.name: temperature_of_soft_xray_detector
disagreements.description: Thermodynamic temperature of the soft X-ray detector assembly, describing its physical thermal state for calibration and monitoring rather than a plasma temperature inferred from radiation.

disagreements.name: energy_confinement_enhancement_factor
disagreements.description: Dimensionless ratio comparing the plasma energy confinement time with the IPB98(y,2) reference scaling prediction.

disagreements.name: toroidal_angle_of_antenna_strap
disagreements.description: Toroidal angular coordinate of each antenna-strap outline point around the machine symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

disagreements.name: volume_of_flux_surface
disagreements.description: Geometric volume contained within a nested magnetic flux surface, cumulative from the magnetic axis toward the outermost closed surface.

disagreements.name: opacity_at_ece_channel_emission_position
disagreements.description: Dimensionless optical depth along the electron-cyclotron-emission viewing path at a channel emission position, indicating whether the detected emission is local and thermal.

disagreements.name: toroidal_angular_width_of_limiter
disagreements.description: Full toroidal angular span of each defined plasma-facing zone associated with a limiter unit.

disagreements.name: spectral_rate
disagreements.description: Calibrated photon-number spectral radiance of plasma emission, resolved by wavelength and viewing direction per projected area, solid angle, and wavelength interval.

disagreements.name: accumulated_deuterium_count_due_to_gas_injection
disagreements.description: Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of deuterium delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown.

disagreements.name: minimum_safety_factor
disagreements.description: Signed safety-factor value on the closed magnetic flux surface where the magnitude of field-line winding is smallest, distinct from that surface’s location.

disagreements.name: total_volumetric_ion_particle_source_rate
disagreements.description: Net per-volume production rate of ion particles summed over species and charge states.

disagreements.name: radial_coordinate_at_outboard_midplane
disagreements.description: Major-radius coordinate of the low-field-side intersection between a magnetic flux surface and the equatorial midplane.

disagreements.name: radial_outline_of_wall
disagreements.description: Major-radius coordinate of every point on a wall boundary outline, measured from the machine symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

disagreements.name: flux_surface_averaged_argon_density_at_plasma_boundary
disagreements.description: Number density of argon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface bounding the confined plasma, summed over all ion charge states and excluding neutral argon.

disagreements.name: total_rate_due_to_fusion
disagreements.description: Rate of neutron production by the plasma, formed by aggregating neutron-generating source contributions over the relevant emitting volume.

disagreements.name: vertical_coordinate_of_pellet_path_point
disagreements.description: Signed vertical (Z) coordinate of a pellet path point in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, measured from the equatorial plane; for two-point path geometry this denotes the second defining point of the pellet injection trajectory.

disagreements.name: radiated_power_over_core_region
disagreements.description: Total electromagnetic power radiated by plasma inside the last closed flux surface, representing the core-region contribution to global radiative energy loss.

disagreements.name: electron_particle_source_rate
disagreements.description: Volume-integrated electron particle source rate inside the enclosing flux surface.

disagreements.name: total_particle_count_accumulated_due_to_gas_injection
disagreements.description: Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of all gas particles delivered since plasma breakdown, summed over every injected species and injection location.

disagreements.name: accumulated_propane_count_due_to_gas_injection
disagreements.description: Cumulative post-breakdown propane inventory delivered by gas injection, expressed as 26 equivalent electrons for each neutral molecule.

checks.question: Is the description imprecise, multi-line, or editorial filler rather than a precise single-line physical definition?
Is the description true of every bound source path?
Does the documentation carry a unit anywhere in prose?
Does the documentation cite a COCOS number in prose rather than stating the direction?
Is the LaTeX escaping broken, with corrupted backslashes?
Is the documentation a diagnostic list, recipe or padding rather than a strict normative definition?
Does the documentation cite a raw DD path or IDS name as storage context?
Which conflict, if any, does this claim have with its DD source definition?
Does the documentation equate the quantity with a related one it is not equal to?
Does the documentation apply a qualifier the physics of the quantity does not admit?
Are the stated equations physically incorrect or dimensionally inconsistent with the quantity?

disagreements.name: ratio_of_particle_count_to_particle_simulated_count
disagreements.label_note: marker weight as real particles per simulated marker matches both sources and the ratio concept
disagreements.description: Dimensionless statistical weight assigning each Monte Carlo marker the number of real particles it represents, expressed as a real-particle count divided by the simulated marker count.

disagreements.name: linear_mhd_mode_reference_phase
disagreements.label_note: phi_ref where the registry phase symbol is varphi
disagreements.description: Signed angular offset that fixes the phase origin of a linear MHD eigenmode relative to its zero-phase complex representation.

disagreements.name: ratio_of_vertical_vorticity_to_major_radius
disagreements.label_note: omega_Z/R as the ratio concept gives, with omega_Z = (curl v).Z-hat; no template applies; links resolve
disagreements.description: Vertical plasma vorticity divided by the local major radius, retaining the signed rotation rate about the vertical axis with inverse-length scaling.

disagreements.name: spectral_efficiency_of_neutron_detector
disagreements.label_note: recorded over incident neutrons per energy band; no registry entry applies; links resolve (the DD text says photon, a DD copy slip)
disagreements.description: Energy-dependent probability that an incident neutron within a specified energy band is recorded as an accepted count by the neutron detector.

description_false_of_some_binding.choice: false of at least one binding

disagreements.name: exposure_time_of_spectrometer_channel
disagreements.label_note: unresolved [incident spectral flux]
disagreements.description: Temporal duration over which a spectrometer channel accumulates incident photons to form one spectral measurement.

disagreements.name: reflected_phase_of_ion_cyclotron_heating_antenna
disagreements.label_note: writes phi (the toroidal-angle symbol) where the registry phase symbol is varphi; unresolved [phase of the ion-cyclotron heating antenna]
disagreements.description: Relative phase angle of a reflected radio-frequency power-wave phasor at an antenna element in an ion-cyclotron heating launcher, measured relative to the forward power-wave phasor of that same element.

disagreements.name: equilibrium_weight_of_interferometer_beam
disagreements.label_note: link text 'calibration coefficient of an interferometer beam' points at spectral_calibration_factor_at_line_of_sight; unresolved [equilibrium weight of a flux loop] and [equilibrium weight of a poloidal magnetic-field probe]
disagreements.description: Dimensionless factor controlling the relative contribution of an interferometer beam’s line-integrated electron-density residual to an equilibrium objective function.

disagreements.name: poloidal_magnetic_flux_at_pellet_path
disagreements.label_note: psi where the registry magnetic-flux symbol is Phi with the poloidal subscript
disagreements.description: Poloidal magnetic flux at a pellet-path point is the value of the equilibrium poloidal magnetic-flux function evaluated at the position of a pellet along its injection trajectory. For an axisymmetric equilibrium it depends only on the major-radius and vertical coordinates of that trajectory point.

disagreements.name: ratio_of_particle_temperature_to_particle_reference_temperature
disagreements.label_note: T_p/T_ref as the ratio concept and temperature_norm; no template applies; link resolves
disagreements.description: Dimensionless ratio comparing a particle species’ kinetic temperature with the positive reference temperature on the same magnetic flux surface.

disagreements.name: poloidal_perturbed_plasma_magnetic_vector_potential_real_part
disagreements.label_note: subscript 'pol' where the registry poloidal symbol is upright p
disagreements.description: Real-valued poloidal component of the perturbed plasma magnetic-vector-potential eigenfunction for a specified toroidal mode in linear MHD stability analysis.

disagreements.name: power_density_due_to_fusion
disagreements.label_note: unresolved [fusion neutron emissivity]
disagreements.description: Local volumetric rate of energy release from all included nuclear-fusion reaction channels, including energy carried by charged particles and neutrons.

disagreements.name: radial_perturbed_vacuum_magnetic_vector_potential_real_part
disagreements.label_note: projects onto the major-radius direction, but the source is mhd_linear coordinate1, the solver's first coordinate rather than R; the name's 'radial' cannot match both registry and source
disagreements.description: Real part of the first-order radial magnetic-vector-potential eigenfunction for a single toroidal mode in the vacuum region.

disagreements.name: toroidal_wave_vector_normalized_of_beam_tracing_beam
disagreements.label_note: unresolved [vertical normalized wave vector of a beam-tracing beam] and [poloidal normalized wave vector of a beam-tracing beam]; also invents a launch-point versus along-path split from its near-duplicate normalized_toroidal_wave_vector_of_beam_tracing_beam
disagreements.description: Toroidal normalized wave vector of a beam-tracing beam is the signed toroidal direction cosine k_phi/|k| of the electromagnetic wave vector at the beam launch point in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

disagreements.name: vertical_coordinate_of_annulus_center
disagreements.label_note: writes z_c where the registry vertical symbol is Z
disagreements.description: Vertical (Z) coordinate locating the geometric center of an annulus in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

disagreements.name: radial_perturbed_plasma_magnetic_field_imaginary_part
disagreements.label_note: uses 'radial' for the flux-coordinate rho direction and says so, against the registry concept of radial as the major-radius direction; the conflict is in the name and registry, which the text exposes
disagreements.description: Imaginary part of the radial flux-coordinate component of the complex first-order perturbed magnetic-field eigenfunction in the confined plasma, for a single toroidal Fourier mode in linear MHD stability analysis. It is not the cylindrical major-radius component.

disagreements.name: decay_length_over_scrape_off_layer
disagreements.label_note: unresolved [ion decay length]
disagreements.description: Characteristic outward distance over which a decaying plasma quantity decreases by one e-folding in the scrape-off layer.

disagreements.name: radius_of_plasma_filament
disagreements.label_note: writes a where the registry radius symbol is R (R would collide with the major radius in the same equation, so the registry entry is the harder fault)
disagreements.description: Radius of a plasma filament is the geometric radius of a circular boundary of the annular cross-section representing a current-carrying plasma filament. In the hollow-disk geometry it denotes either the inner or outer boundary radius.

disagreements.name: total_neutron_source_rate_due_to_thermal_fusion
disagreements.label_note: unresolved per-channel source-rate references; physics and template otherwise sound
disagreements.description: Total neutron production rate from thermonuclear neutron-producing deuterium-deuterium, deuterium-tritium, and tritium-tritium reaction branches among Maxwellian bulk ions, excluding beam-target and beam-beam fast-ion contributions.

disagreements.name: twist_period_of_fiber_optic_current_sensor
disagreements.label_note: unresolved [fiber optic current sensor period] and [polarization beat length]
disagreements.description: Repeat arclength along the sensing-fiber centerline at which the effective birefringent-axis orientation completes one spatial cycle.

disagreements.name: wave_mode_number
disagreements.label_note: unresolved [mode number]
disagreements.description: Dimensionless mode-number vector labeling the discrete Fourier periodicities of a coherent wave perturbation.

improvements.change: Supply DD source, parent and sibling evidence to source-sensitive name checks
improvements.evidence: Name dd_source_docs {'nonempty': 295, 'empty': 406}; parent_path {'nonempty': 290, 'unobserved': 411}; sibling_fields {'unobserved': 701}; derived_children {'unobserved': 701}. bound_to_wrong_object validation AUC 0.6996, but its 0.5 cutoff falsely flags 76 acceptable items. Preserve source absence as unknown and measure applicability rather than forcing a defect answer.
improvements.expected_auc_effect: No point forecast is identifiable from frozen answers. Expected improvement is concentrated in source-sensitive checks; zero immediate gain without rejudging. The available-full-catalog audit replay separately changes 364 dead-link findings but produces exactly zero rubric AUC gain, so evidence plumbing alone must not be advertised as a measured discrimination gain.

improvements.change: Rewrite raw_dd_reference_in_prose to identify an offending span in candidate prose and distinguish canonical quantity names
improvements.evidence: Validation AUC 0.5693; 55/74 acceptable entries flagged. ratio_of_particle_count_to_particle_simulated_count is labelled acceptable and receives P(defect)=0.83, although its prose contains canonical particle_count/particle_simulated_count identifiers rather than a raw DD path. Its source paths appear separately in the state. This motivates a candidate-text-only question with a span, not reversal of polarity.
improvements.expected_auc_effect: Unknown before a paired question arm. Simply removing this term is not supported: calibration AUC rises 0.014371 but validation falls 0.016708. Retain the check until a rewritten question demonstrates improvement on fresh labels.

improvements.change: Add check-specific and dimension-specific golden labels, including completeness and paired provenance corrections
improvements.candidate: add golden labels of a named kind
improvements.evidence: The frozen fixtures label whole-item defensibility. No exact check-level defect count is known. Documentation complete has only 3 calibration defects and 0 validation defects; exact subtypes of the 14 physics, 23 subject and 10 scope defects are unlabelled. The name gold has 194 human source/target pairs; label which check each edit fixes and add matched acceptable controls, keeping copy groups together. Dimension models currently fit the same binary target without dimension gold scores.
improvements.expected_auc_effect: Zero immediate AUC change; gain after retraining is unknown. Obtain at least five independent defect groups per targeted check before even provisional calibration, plus a fresh grouped validation set. Five is a minimum identifiability screen, not a precision guarantee.

improvements.change: Refit name dimension mappings against dimension labels and separate documentation non-support from contradiction
improvements.evidence: Name validation grammar rubric AUC is 0.6240 and convention 0.6439, while raw category AUCs are 0.5466 and 0.5651. The existing logistic reference exceeds the raw rubric by 0.022911 AUC on identical receipts. Docs physics has no category question; the claim non-support channel is near chance (0.4959) despite a functioning hard contradiction veto (60/60 planted contradictions, 0/20 silent controls). Removing its fitted term gives calibration delta 0.000193 and validation delta 0.000123.
improvements.expected_auc_effect: The name reference gap of 0.022911 is a measured comparison target, not a forecast for a new mapping. The claim-term sensitivity is only about +0.000123 validation AUC, far short of the proposed 0.85 target. Preserve the hard veto, fit only within calibration, and test the mapping with new independent labels.

limitations: Golden truth is whole-item only. Name label_source is provenance, not a defect taxonomy; docs label_check is a broad primary reason, not a complete per-check annotation. Thus no check has a measured exact defect count, and no check-specific sensitivity can be calibrated from these receipts. AUC by check and dimension is against overall defensibility. Deterministic docs audit values reproduce the calibration builder with a one-item catalog and known-id set; this context is narrower than the catalog frozen alongside the receipts. Absent name audit answers are unknown. Ablations hold every other parameter fixed and replace a term by its calibration mean; they are diagnostics, not refitted or independently validated improvements. Repeated validation inspection makes a fresh grouped holdout necessary before deployment. Missing evidence and sparse labels do not identify a numerical future AUC gain.
